display_name: Pensions Act 2008 (UK) under one top-level goal — automatic enrolment status, qualifying earnings and the s 20 minimum contributions, and the fixed and escalating penalty notices — and those three goals

others: the contributions meet the quality requirement in … with (pa08-status.l4)

scope: Goal-focused, at the user's direction: ss 1(1), 3(1)-(4), (6B), 7(1)-(2), 9(1), 13(1)-(2), 20(1)-(1A), 40(4)-(5), 41(2), (4)-(6) of the revised text as at 29 June 2026 (£10,000 trigger, £6,240-£50,270 band). Left out on purpose: re-enrolment, opt-out mechanics, information duties, other quality requirements, Master Trust approval, transitional periods, compliance notices, Parts 2-6.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-18 (tests-independent.l4, 90 assertions from expectations written before the encoding was read); two failed (s 3(3)-(4): an excepted jobholder falls to s 7, so may opt in unless already in a qualifying scheme) and the encoding was corrected. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: Ages and pensionable age judged on the first day of the pay reference period.
forks.F3: More than £10,000, pro rata by months/12, no rounding.
forks.F4: Qualifying earnings between the scaled limits.
forks.F5: No qualifying earnings: s 9 unless already in a s 9 scheme.
forks.F6: s 20(1)(a): employer contribution must be more than 0.
forks.F7: Fixed penalty payment date at least issue + 28.
forks.F8: Escalating penalty from the start date until (not including) compliance; 0 if barred, over £10,000 a day, or starting too early.
forks.F9: s 3(3)-(4) disapply only s 3(2): the jobholder falls to s 7 (may opt in unless already an active member).
